say:5:1736303004:0.source_cn: 钱少不了你的。明白了吗？

say:7:1736303005:0.text: Y-You aren't my contact?! Then who on earth are you?!
say:7:1736303005:0.source_cn: 你……你不是接头人？！你是谁？！
say:7:1736303005:0.male: Y-You aren't my contact?! Then who on earth are you?!
say:7:1736303005:0.female: Y-You aren't my contact?! Then who on earth are you?!

say:8:1736303006:1.text: How dare you trick me like this! I'm dumping you into the river!
say:8:1736303006:1.source_cn: 该死！竟敢套我的话！看我不把你扔进河里喂鱼！
say:8:1736303006:1.male: How dare you trick me like this! I'm dumping you into the river!
say:8:1736303006:1.female: How dare you trick me like this! I'm dumping you into the river!

fork:300:17363040:say:1:1736304001:1.text: Okay, okay, stop hitting me! You just want tea, right? I'll spill everything!
fork:300:17363040:say:1:1736304001:1.source_cn: 别打了！你不就是想打听消息吗！我说，我全说！
fork:300:17363040:say:1:1736304001:1.male: Okay, okay, stop hitting me! You just want tea, right? I'll spill everything!
fork:300:17363040:say:1:1736304001:1.female: Okay, okay, stop hitting me! You just want tea, right? I'll spill everything!

fork:300:17363040:say:2:1736304002:1.text: Okay, so Lord Lumberton gets information from his people through the water routes. I'm just helping him collect it! I promise I don't know anything else!
fork:300:17363040:say:2:1736304002:1.source_cn: 伦巴顿老爷一直在通过赛凡纳的水路买消息，我只是听伦巴顿...

fork:300:17363040:say:4:1736304004:1.text: If I get caught, I won't be able to make a living at the docks anymore!
fork:300:17363040:say:4:1736304004:1.source_cn: 求求你，别把这事捅给守备军，否则我就没法在码头混了！
